suite: annotate bind form (a drag keeps the pick, the ends by name, the leader)
expect_red: with one end bound, the form shows the bound end as taken, with its face, and the remaining end preselected -- both by interface name

mutations.contract: With one end bound, the form preselects the remaining end and shows the bound one as taken, with its face.
mutations.note: Treats one end bound like none: both offered, nothing preselected, so a reader re-chooses an answer the record already has and may choose the taken end.
mutations.find: return { ends: ends, choices: needed.slice(), selected: needed[0] };
mutations.replace: return { ends: ends, choices: AA.DIRECTIONS.slice(), selected: null };
